name: manage_timelines
description:
Manage the project's timelines (sequences). A project can hold multiple timelines; one is your current working timeline and is the default target for edits, timeline frame inspection, and exports. The user's currently viewed timeline is supplied separately in editor context and may differ.

Actions:
- list: all timelines and which is the current working target.
- create: new timeline, born with a default video track and ready to receive items from the asset library. Composition inherits the working timeline; override with width/height or ratio ("16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4"). To create several timelines, pass them all in one call via timelines (an array of {name, ratio, width, height} entries).
- duplicate: full copy of timelineId — tracks, items, markers, captions including word-level edits. Its transcript script is immediately editable with read_script/apply_script.
- switch: make timelineId your working timeline. Applies immediately to later tool calls without moving clients that keep selection local. Legacy clients may still follow through their compatibility selection row. A hidden timeline can't be selected — restore it first (update hidden=false).
- update: rename (name), change composition (width/height/ratio), and/or hide/restore (hidden) timelineId, defaulting to the working timeline. On size changes, fit controls how existing items adapt: "contain" keeps everything visible, "cover" fills the frame. Hiding keeps all data but removes the timeline's tab; clients viewing it select a remaining visible timeline.
- delete: remove timelineId, or several at once via timelineIds in one atomic call. Clients viewing a deleted timeline land on a remaining timeline. A project keeps at least one timeline.

create and duplicate make the new timeline the working target by default so subsequent edits land on it (batch create targets the last entry); pass activate=false to leave the working target alone. Name collisions auto-suffix "(2)".
For composition size, use ratio presets OR explicit width/height. Redundant preset dimensions are accepted (e.g. ratio:"9:16", width:1080, height:1920), but custom dimensions must omit ratio.

Choosing a starting point: duplicate when the new timeline should start from existing content (cut-downs, versions, language variants — trim the copy via its script); create when building fresh from the asset library.

Returns JSON; timeline objects are {id, name, width, height, active, hidden}.

action.description: list, create, duplicate, switch, update, or delete

activate.description: create/duplicate: false to keep the current active timeline. Defaults to true.

fit.description: update: how existing items adapt to a new canvas size. "contain" keeps everything visible, "cover" fills the frame.

height.description: Composition height in pixels for create/update

hidden.description: update: true hides the timeline (its tab disappears for everyone but data is kept; restorable), false restores it. The last visible timeline cannot be hidden.

name.description: Timeline name for create/duplicate; new name for update

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

timelineId.description: Target timeline id from action=list (required for duplicate/switch; delete takes this or timelineIds; optional for update, which defaults to the active timeline)

timelineIds.description: delete: several timeline ids/prefixes from action=list, removed atomically in one call.

timelines.description: create: specs for creating several timelines in one call; each entry takes name/ratio/width/height and inherits unset composition from the active timeline. Top-level activate applies to the last entry.

width.description: Composition width in pixels for create/update
